VENKATESH KONIJETI

Senior Cloud Data Engineer  

 +1 (248) 916-4124   •   venkatesh.c7276@gmail.com •  



PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior cloud data engineer with 10+ years designing and operating enterprise data warehouses, ELT pipelines, and analytics platforms for Fortune 500 supply-chain and logistics clients. Deep SQL background — advanced joins, window functions, CTEs, recursive queries, MERGE / QUALIFY patterns, and hands-on performance tuning of long-running queries against multi-billion-row warehouses. Hands-on with Snowflake (Streams / Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, External Tables, Zero-Copy Cloning, warehouse workload management) and equivalent depth in BigQuery — the two are conceptually parallel, and my ELT patterns port between them cleanly. Comfortable building transformations in Coalesce (dbt-family, Snowflake-native) and in dbt-style layered SQL. Cloud primary experience on Azure (Data Factory, Synapse, ADLS, Key Vault) and GCP (BigQuery, GCS, Pub/Sub, Composer / Airflow); working knowledge of AWS equivalents (S3, IAM, Redshift, Glue). Automation-minded, obsessed with first-time-right delivery, and used to translating vague business asks into production data solutions.

CORE TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

Languages

SQL (advanced), Python, Bash / shell, Jinja (dbt / Coalesce templates)

Cloud Data Warehouses

Snowflake — Streams & Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe (batch + streaming), External Tables, Zero-Copy Cloning, Time Travel, warehouse sizing / auto-suspend / auto-resume, resource monitors, workload management, RBAC, secure views, masking policies.  BigQuery — partitioning, clustering, materialized views, BI Engine, slot reservations, INFORMATION_SCHEMA-based cost governance

Advanced SQL

Window functions (LAG / LEAD / ROW_NUMBER / RANK / QUALIFY), CTEs + recursive CTEs, MERGE / UPSERT patterns, pivots, semi / anti joins, correlated subqueries, execution-plan reading, predicate pushdown, cluster + partition pruning, cost-based query rewrites

Data Transformation

Coalesce (Snowflake-native, dbt-family — node graphs, macros, deployment plans), dbt-style layered SQL (staging / intermediate / marts), Jinja templating, model tests, source-freshness checks

Data Modeling

Dimensional modeling, star / snowflake schemas, SCD Type 1/2, medallion (bronze / silver / gold), fact + dimension design, surrogate keys, slowly-changing history tables, data vault basics

Event Streaming & CDC

Apache Kafka (topic + partition design, consumer groups, DLQ), Pub/Sub, Debezium (working), Snowpipe streaming, Snowflake Streams for change tracking, transactional-outbox pattern, exactly-once effect

Ways of Working

Agile (Scrum + Kanban), first-time-right / zero-defect delivery discipline, RFC / ADR writing, direct business-stakeholder translation, mentoring, knowledge-sharing sessions, code + query review culture

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Capital One  —  Cloud Data Engineering

Mclean, VA  ·  2024 – Present

Enterprise data warehouse, analytics + ML feature layer for 50+ fulfillment centers

Own the AI-ready data warehouse layer feeding decisioning services across the Merchandise Movement platform — event-driven CDC from operational systems into a medallion (raw / staging / marts) model with strict partitioning + clustering discipline.

Hands-on with Snowflake alongside BigQuery — built and maintain a set of Snowflake schemas for analytics workloads: sized virtual warehouses (multi-cluster + auto-suspend), used Streams + Tasks for change-data processing, Dynamic Tables for continuously-refreshed marts, Snowpipe for near-real-time file ingest, Zero-Copy Cloning for safe environment refresh, and Time Travel for point-in-time recovery.

Build transformations in Coalesce — modeled the graph of source, staging, intermediate, and mart nodes; wrote Jinja macros for shared logic (SCD-2 handling, surrogate-key hashing, DQ assertions); wired deployment plans into Git-backed release gates so promotion between dev / stage / prod is a PR, not a click.

Retail supply chain, warehouse operations, inventory & replenishment, order management, EDI (X12 850/856/810), operational analytics

Advanced-SQL heavy — routinely write window-function-based fact rebuilds, recursive CTEs for hierarchy walks (org / product / location), MERGE / QUALIFY patterns for idempotent upserts, and rewrite legacy queries into pushdown-friendly forms. Cut several long-running dashboards from multi-minute waits to sub-10 seconds by fixing predicate placement + adding the right cluster keys.

Own end-to-end data-quality gates — freshness checks, row-count anomalies, null-rate SLOs, and cross-source reconciliation queries wired into Airflow with PagerDuty callbacks. Any DQ breach blocks downstream marts from refreshing so bad data never leaves silver.

Architected the Kafka event backbone that feeds the warehouse — partition strategy on natural business keys for per-entity ordering, DLQ off-ramps with reprocessing, schema-registry-driven contracts, and Debezium-style CDC into staging tables.

Codified warehouse + orchestration infrastructure in Terraform + Helm — Snowflake accounts, warehouses, roles, and RBAC bindings; BigQuery datasets, IAM, Cloud Composer environments. Environment drift stopped being a mystery and became an audited pull request.

Drove Snowflake + BigQuery cost governance — resource monitors on Snowflake warehouses, per-team credit budgets, and BigQuery slot reservation tuning with INFORMATION_SCHEMA-based cost dashboards. Identified and rewrote a handful of runaway queries that were burning outsized credits without adding value.

Partner directly with product, operations, and analytics stakeholders — take vague asks ("we need to see how peak-season staffing decisions moved throughput"), turn them into modeled facts + dashboards, and ship first-time-right. Recognized with the 2024 Walmart Bravo Award for cross-team impact and the 2024 One Atlas WMS Innovation Recognition.

Walmart Global Tech  —  Data Platform Engineer

Bentonville, AR  ·  20 – 2024

Cloud modernization of warehouse execution + operational data pipelines

Built and operated ELT pipelines feeding the enterprise warehouse from operational sources — CDC from SQL Server + Cassandra into Azure ADLS + GCS partitioned Parquet, then into BigQuery / Azure Synapse marts. Landed the raw layer via streaming (Kafka + Pub/Sub) and batch (Azure Data Factory + Airflow).

Deep SQL performance tuning across SQL Server + Azure SQL + BigQuery — analyzed execution plans, rewrote correlated-subquery-heavy reports as window-function pipelines, added the right indexes / partition + cluster keys, and pushed predicate placement to enable pushdown. Multiple reports moved from timing-out to sub-second.

Designed and integrated distributed warehouse domains via Kafka event streams — topic strategy (partition count, retention, compaction), consumer-group layout, dead-letter handling, schema evolution via versioned event contracts, consumer-lag alerting. Kafka is the CDC + integration backbone feeding downstream analytical layers.

Led modernization of legacy on-prem warehouse systems onto Azure — containerized services with Docker / AKS, migrated stateful stores with zero-downtime cutover strategies (shadow, dual-write, controlled cutover). Started replacing bespoke deploy scripts with Terraform so infra changes went through PR review.

Hardened Jenkins CI/CD pipelines with automated unit / integration / SQL-linting test gates plus SonarQube quality gates — made blue-green + canary the default rather than the exception. Adopted SqlFluff + dbt-style test discipline on the data side.

Owned production support for mission-critical data pipelines + WMS services. First-responder on P1/P2 incidents — triaged from Splunk / Application Insights, ran the war-room bridge, wrote post-incident writeups, and turned each into a runbook so the next person didn't relearn from scratch.

Cross-team architecture reviews and standardized data contracts across the Merchandise Movement family; the go-to Kafka reviewer on adjacent teams. Received the 2022 Atlas Moves Product Launch Recognition for delivery leadership.

Wells FARGO  — Sr. Data Engineer

Charlotte, NC  ·  2018 – 2022

Manufacturing plant data pipelines, SQL optimization, and operational analytics

Improved backend warehouse throughput ~15% via analytical SQL optimization — index strategy, execution-plan analysis, partition pruning, batch ETL tuning, and connection-pool hardening across high-volume integration jobs. Straightforward advanced-SQL work: rewriting nested-loop plans as hash joins with the right filter placement, folding correlated subqueries into window functions.

Built ETL and near-real-time data-integration pipelines feeding downstream analytical warehouses — SQL Server + Oracle sources, staged in flat-file lakes, loaded via SSIS + custom Python. Introduced contract-driven data feeds + validation gates that reduced silent-corruption incidents.

Delivered operational dashboards and alerting for inventory and supply-chain data pipelines, cutting leadership decision-making latency by ~20%. Owned the underlying models + the SQL powering the dashboards; iterated with plant-ops stakeholders directly.

Engineered fault-tolerant IBM MQ and ActiveMQ integrations connecting enterprise inventory, purchasing, and warehouse systems across North American manufacturing plants. Standardized retry, DLQ, and reconciliation patterns.

Active participant in code + query reviews and design discussions across integration teams — championed testability, defensive coding, and clear service boundaries; mentored two junior engineers through their first production rollouts.

Fidelity  —  Data Engineer

Texas, TX  ·  2015 – 2018

Consulting delivery for Fortune 500 retail and logistics clients on JDA / RedPrairie / Manhattan platforms

Delivered 20+ backend + data enhancements across global order management, EDI, and warehouse execution systems for Fortune 500 retail and logistics clients — the classic consulting delivery model, working directly with client stakeholders.

Built and maintained enterprise document-workflow integrations handling multi-region logistics operations and semi-structured EDI data exchange (X12 850/856/810), with reliable failure handling and reconciliation.

Supported large-scale logistics data flows through deep debugging, SQL performance tuning, and stability improvements — built the production-support fundamentals (log-diving, execution-plan diagnosis, DB-lock triage) that later shaped my Walmart on-call practice.

Regularly presented technical solutions to client stakeholders and offshore delivery leadership; early exposure to consulting-style engagement rhythms (SoW, delivery estimates, steering committees, defect governance).

Comfortable building transformations in Coalesce (dbt-family, Snowflake-native) and in dbt-style layered SQL. Cloud primary experience on Azure (Data Factory, Synapse, ADLS, Key Vault) and GCP (BigQuery, GCS, Pub/Sub, Composer / Airflow); working knowledge of AWS equivalents (S3, IAM, Redshift, Glue). Automation-minded, obsessed with first-time-right delivery, and used to translating vague business asks into production data solutions.

Languages

SQL (advanced), Python, Bash / shell, Jinja (dbt / Coalesce templates)

Cloud Data Warehouses

Snowflake — Streams & Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe (batch + streaming), External Tables, Zero-Copy Cloning, Time Travel, warehouse sizing / auto-suspend / auto-resume, resource monitors, workload management, RBAC, secure views, masking policies.  BigQuery — partitioning, clustering, materialized views, BI Engine, slot reservations, INFORMATION_SCHEMA-based cost governance

Advanced SQL

Window functions (LAG / LEAD / ROW_NUMBER / RANK / QUALIFY), CTEs + recursive CTEs, MERGE / UPSERT patterns, pivots, semi / anti joins, correlated subqueries, execution-plan reading, predicate pushdown, cluster + partition pruning, cost-based query rewrites

Data Transformation

Coalesce (Snowflake-native, dbt-family — node graphs, macros, deployment plans), dbt-style layered SQL (staging / intermediate / marts), Jinja templating, model tests, source-freshness checks

Dimensional modeling, star / snowflake schemas, SCD Type 1/2, medallion (bronze / silver / gold), fact + dimension design, surrogate keys, slowly-changing history tables, data vault basics

Apache Kafka (topic + partition design, consumer groups, DLQ), Pub/Sub, Debezium (working), Snowpipe streaming, Snowflake Streams for change tracking, transactional-outbox pattern, exactly-once effect

Agile (Scrum + Kanban), first-time-right / zero-defect delivery discipline, RFC / ADR writing, direct business-stakeholder translation, mentoring, knowledge-sharing sessions, code + query review culture

VENKAT PILLARISETTY

Tampa, FL, USA • +1 267-281-4180 • vpillarisetty1@gmail.com • https://www.linkedin.com/in/vpillarisetty



SUMMARY





Senior Data Engineer with 11+ years of experience architecting and delivering scalable Lakehouse, cloud data platform, and distributed data engineering solutions across AWS and Microsoft Azure. Deep expertise in Databricks, Delta Lake, Medallion Architecture, Apache Spark (PySpark/Spark SQL/Scala), Unity Catalog governance, and batch and real-time streaming pipelines (Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Kinesis) processing tens of millions of records daily. Hands-on experience with Hadoop, HDFS, Hive, Impala, HBase, Snowﬂake, Redshift, dbt, Airﬂow, and Terraform/CloudFormation infrastructure automation. Proven track record of reducing infrastructure costs by 25-35%, improving pipeline runtime by ~30%, and leading on-premises-to-cloud lakehouse migrations in ﬁnancial services, hospitality, and telecom. Experienced with GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI workﬂows using OpenAI APIs and LangChain.

SKILLS





Cloud Platforms: AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda, Kinesis, EC2, IAM, KMS, CloudFormation, CloudWatch); Azure (Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Monitor)

Databricks, Big Data & Query Engines: Databricks, Delta Lake, Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), Data Mesh, Unity Catalog, Databricks Jobs/Workﬂows, Databricks SQL, Databricks Genie, Delta Sharing, MLﬂow, Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, Hadoop, HDFS, YARN, Hive, Impala, HBase, MapReduce, Conﬂuent Kafka, Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Parquet, ORC, Trino, Starburst, Presto, Apache Drill, Amazon Athena

Data Warehousing, Modeling & Virtualization: Snowﬂake, Snowpipe, Amazon Redshift, Azure Synapse, Star Schema, Snowﬂake Schema, Dimensional Modeling, Data Vault, OLTP/OLAP, 3NF, Logical & Physical Data Modeling, Denodo VDP/VQL, Base/Derived/Business Views, Semantic Layers, Data Products

Orchestration, Integration & Databases: Apache Airﬂow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, dbt, Temporal, IBM DataStage, API Integration, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB

Programming & Scripting: Python, SQL, PySpark, Scala, Java, PL/SQL, Unix/Linux Shell Scripting, Bash

AI, ML & LLM Engineering: Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLM Integration (OpenAI APIs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, LangChain, Tool Calling, MLﬂow, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, FAISS, GitHub Copilot, Claude AI, Cursor DevOps, Governance, Security & Monitoring: Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM Templates, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, RBAC, Data Lineage, PII Protection, Least-Privilege Access, PCI-DSS, SOX, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Denodo Data Catalog

Visualization: Power BI, Tableau

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE



Senior Data Engineer

American Express	Nov 2023 - Present

Architected and implemented an enterprise Medallion Lakehouse on Databricks and Delta Lake, deﬁning reusable Bronze ingestion, Silver validation/enrichment, and Gold dimensional-modeling patterns for multi-terabyte ﬁnancial datasets consumed by 10+ business units.

Led delivery of 25+ production Python and PySpark batch and streaming pipelines processing tens of millions of records daily across card transactions, rewards, offer eligibility, and customer segmentation.

Built near-real-time ﬁnancial-event pipelines using Conﬂuent Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming, applying checkpointing, fault recovery, exactly-once semantics, and idempotent writes into Delta Lake tables.

Engineered Delta Lake incremental-processing patterns using ACID transactions, schema enforcement/evolution, time travel, and MERGE INTO operations to handle reversals, corrections, and late-arriving events.

Optimized Spark and Delta workloads through partitioning, caching, ﬁle compaction, data skipping, and query-plan tuning, reducing average pipeline runtime by ~30% and EMR/cluster costs by up to 35%.

Implemented Unity Catalog governance across 150+ Delta tables and six business teams, centralizing RBAC, PII protection, and data lineage; supported PCI-DSS and SOX compliance through encryption and audit logging.

Led Databricks Genie from proof of concept through production, exposing curated Gold-layer tables as a semantic layer and enabling natural-language, self-service analysis that cut ad hoc reporting turnaround time.

Architected a complementary enterprise AWS data lake (S3, EC2, Glue, EMR, Athena, Redshift), led migration of legacy on-premises platforms onto it, and developed modular dbt models for Snowﬂake/Redshift; orchestrated fault-tolerant workﬂows via Apache Airﬂow and Temporal.

Supported hybrid Spark/Hadoop modernization by integrating Databricks and PySpark pipelines with enterprise HDFS architecture, using YARN-managed processing, Hive/Impala SQL, and HBase NoSQL access patterns for ingestion, validation, and reconciliation.



Implemented federated query capabilities using Trino, Presto, and Apache Drill for cross-source analytics spanning MySQL, Hive, and S3-based datasets without physical data movement.

Developed reusable PySpark feature-engineering pipelines for offer-propensity scoring (XGBoost), customer churn prediction, fraud-signal detection, and spend forecasting, with experiment tracking and model versioning via MLﬂow.

Designed domain-oriented Bronze/Silver/Gold data products under a Data Mesh model, deﬁning data-product standards covering ownership, data contracts, schema management, and service-level expectations across customer, transaction, rewards, and segmentation domains.

Designed logical and physical data models (3NF, star schema, dimensional modeling) to deliver reusable data products for reporting, analytics, and machine-learning use cases.

Developed GenAI and RAG proof-of-concepts using OpenAI APIs, LangChain, and governed enterprise data, evaluating tool-using agentic patterns for metadata discovery and analytics assistance.

Partnered with data scientists, product managers, software engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to shape the data-platform roadmap, document technical designs, lead code reviews, and mentor engineers.

Senior Data Engineer

Remington Hospitality	Aug 2021 - Oct 2023

Architected an Azure Synapse enterprise data warehouse from scratch, unifying revenue, occupancy, reservations, and property operations data across 100+ hotel properties into a single governed platform.

Developed scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Python, PySpark, and Spark SQL to process more than 5 TB of operational data monthly.

Led end-to-end migration of on-premises SQL Server workloads to Azure, including dependency assessment, pipeline refactoring, data validation, and production cutover, reducing infrastructure costs by ~30%.

Designed and implemented Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) in Azure Data Lake Gen2, enforcing data quality at every tier and enabling governed self-service consumption for BI teams.

Implemented Spark SQL and Spark Streaming pipelines for high-volume batch and real-time feeds using HBase as a distributed NoSQL store, enabling near-real-time property performance dashboards.

Built dimensional (Star/Snowﬂake schema) models and analytics-ready datasets integrating property-management, reservation, SQL Server, and enterprise reporting systems for revenue and operations reporting.

Built CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions to automate deployment of Databricks notebooks and ADF pipelines, reducing release cycles from weekly to daily, and delivered self-service Power BI dashboards adopted by 50+ property managers across the portfolio.

Optimized Databricks workloads and cluster auto-scaling through partitioning, caching, and Spark tuning, improving scalability and reliability while reducing peak-season compute costs by ~20% and pipeline failure rates by ~45%.

Senior Data Engineer

Telstra	Jul 2018 - Jun 2021

Architected an Amazon S3 data lake for large-scale telecommunications call-detail-record (CDR) and network datasets, enabling reliable processing of 100M+ subscriber records daily.

Designed and developed distributed Python and PySpark workloads on Amazon EMR, tuning Spark execution, partitioning, memory usage, and cluster resources for high-volume batch analytics.

Drove the shift from batch to near-real-time analytics via Amazon Kinesis and Apache Kafka ingestion pipelines, reducing data latency from T+1 to sub-hour for network performance data.

Developed AWS Glue ETL pipelines with schema evolution and metadata management via the AWS Glue Data Catalog, improving dataset discoverability across 200+ datasets.

Provisioned AWS infrastructure using Terraform and CloudFormation, enabling repeatable, code-driven deployments and cutting environment provisioning time by ~70%.

Optimized S3 lifecycle policies and EMR cluster conﬁgurations, reducing AWS infrastructure costs by approximately 25% while maintaining 99.95% SLA compliance.

Built automated data-quality and reconciliation pipelines in PySpark to validate CDR feeds at ingestion, reducing downstream data-quality incidents by ~40%; acted as internal technical go-to, guiding junior engineers on AWS and PySpark best practices.

Data Engineer

Telstra	Apr 2015 - Jun 2018

Developed large-scale Hadoop pipelines using Spark, PySpark, Hive, Impala, and MapReduce across HDFS-based telecommunications network, usage, and subscriber datasets.

Worked with Hadoop/HDFS architecture and YARN resource management to schedule, monitor, and tune distributed processing workloads; built Hive and HBase access patterns and tuned Impala SQL for low-latency analytics.

Converted raw structured and semi-structured datasets into partitioned Parquet and ORC formats, reducing storage footprint by ~50% and improving query performance by up to 3x.



Automated ﬁle handling, ingestion, validation, and monitoring using Unix/Linux shell scripts; developed complex SQL and PL/SQL in TOAD for transformation, reporting, and reconciliation.

Developed and supported IBM DataStage ETL jobs, replacing manual reporting workﬂows and saving 20+ hours of analyst effort per week; contributed to migrating ETL workﬂows from DataStage to Apache Spark.

Designed and maintained Hive metastore schemas and Star Schema models, and implemented Apache Airﬂow orchestration to automate dependencies and retry logic, reducing job execution failures by ~30%.



CERTIFICATIONS



Databricks Certiﬁed Data Engineer Professional



EDUCATION



University of Central Missouri - Missouri, USA Master of Computer Science | 2022

Charles Sturt University - Melbourne, Australia Master of Information Technology | 2017 JNTUH - Hyderabad, India

Bachelor of Computer Science | 2014



KEY ACHIEVEMENTS



Cost Reduction: 25-35% AWS/Azure infrastructure savings delivered across 3 companies.

Pipeline Performance: ~40% data-processing SLA improvement at American Express; up to 60% Athena scan-volume reduction at Telstra.

Scale Delivered: 100M+ CDR records/day at Telstra; 5TB+ monthly data processing at Remington Hospitality.

Uptime Achieved: 99.9% pipeline uptime at American Express through automated data-quality checks and anomaly detection.

Team Impact: Improved team delivery velocity by ~30% through mentorship and reusable pipeline templates.

Migrations Led: 3 full on-premises-to-cloud migrations across AWS and Azure throughout career.

Professional Summary:

5 years of experience specializing in building scalable Big Data pipelines, ETL workflows, and cloud data platforms.

Work Experience:

KnackHook  | November 2025 - Present 

Data Engineer 

Responsibilities:

Designed and implemented end-to-end data pipelines using PySpark and Python within the Databricks ecosystem, ingesting aviation operational data from Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) and external public datasets for large-scale analytical processing.

Built and managed workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow, scheduling complex ETL pipelines, managing dependencies, retries, and parallel execution to ensure reliable and scalable data processing.

Architected a Databricks Lakehouse architecture leveraging Delta Lake on ADLS, implementing a Bronze–Silver–Gold data architecture to ingest raw operational datasets and transform them into curated analytics-ready datasets.

Applied core Data Warehousing principles and Star Schema modeling, designing Fact and Dimension tables to support scalable analytics across flight operations, passenger data, and logistics metrics.

Developed and optimized Delta Lake tables with partitioning strategies, file compaction, and data layout optimizations to improve query performance, reliability, and storage efficiency.

Wrote and optimized complex SQL transformations and PySpark jobs within Databricks to process large datasets, enabling efficient data aggregation and transformation for downstream analytics.

Integrated internal operational datasets with external aviation market datasets to create a unified analytical dataset for competitor benchmarking and operational insights.

Built curated Gold-layer datasets and analytical data models in Databricks to support business intelligence and advanced analytics workloads.

Collaborated with data analysts, business stakeholders, and operations teams to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical data models, and deliver reliable datasets for reporting and analysis.

Enabled downstream reporting by delivering optimized datasets for Power BI dashboards, supporting operational insights such as route performance, passenger trends, and logistics analytics.



Adobe | May 2025 – October 2025 

Data Engineer III

Responsibilities:

Developed the migration for Databricks serverless compute, identifying Spark limitations and creating reusable Airflow templates in Python for streamlined execution.

Designed and built scalable Delta Live Tables (DLT) pipelines in Databricks to automate data ingestion, transformation, and quality enforcement within the Lakehouse architecture.

Refactored existing batch ETL pipelines to Delta Live Tables, enabling incremental processing, improved pipeline reliability, and simplified orchestration compared to legacy Airflow-based workflows.

Maintained and enhanced an asset monitoring framework in PySpark and SQL to track production pipeline health and autocreate Jira tickets on failures, improving issue visibility and response time. 

Operated GDPR compliance pipelines on silver tables to process privacy deletion requests, including log retention management and optimization of large datasets prior to deletion to ensure cost efficiency and performance. 

Optimized queries using Spark deletion vectors, vectorized readers, and serverless compute to maintain cost-effective, highperformance pipelines. 

Identified performance bottlenecks caused by data spikes during new feature additions due to heavy group-by operations and proposed a redesign approach using Star Schema that reduced column categorizations by nearly 30×. 

Partnered with data scientists to deliver clean, well-structured datasets for ML and implemented feature backfill automation utilizing SQL and Python. 

Refactored ETL scripts and Databricks/Airflow pipelines with a focus on performance tuning and storage efficiency, fine-tuning Spark jobs and delta lake features like optimized partitioning, bucketing, and Z-ordering to improve runtime and scalability.

Helped stakeholders manage costs by recommending and implementing best data engineering practices across Databricks and Airflow pipelines. 

Enhanced Power BI dashboards by integrating new features and modifying upstream scripts to support business requirements. 

Orchestrated tasks using Apache Airflow and Databricks workflows, managing retries, delay strategies, and parallelism for serverless clusters. Refactored pipelines to leverage Airflow’s native parallelism features, improving task visibility and simplifying debugging. 



Koantek  | March 2024 - April 2025  

Data Engineer

Responsibilities:

Migrated data from Snowflake to Databricks using ADLS as a staging area with secure service principle integration, and optimized ETL scripts in Python to ensure seamless integration with PostgreSQL, SQL Server validating transformations in Databricks notebooks with PySpark and Spark SQL.

Designed and implemented data pipelines using ADF to orchestrate data movement between ADLS, Databricks and Snowflake.

Implemented the Medallion architecture in Databricks, transforming data across bronze, silver, and gold layers, and utilized Delta Live Tables and Autoloader to handle incremental data loads and streaming data improving pipeline efficiency by 40%.

Orchestrated DBT scripts in legacy Airflow pipelines handling retries, parallelism and dependencies eficiently.

Managed Unity Catalog in Databricks for data governance and security, implementing granular access controls, lineage tracking, and role-based permissions.

Designed and implemented Databricks Asset Bundles from scratch, creating templates for Autoloader, Delta Live Tables, and workflows, for seamless deployment and CI/CD automation via GitHub Actions.

Leveraged GitHub for version control in the CI/CD and DevOps practices and implemented GitHub actions with Python scripts, reducing data ingestion time by 50%.

Converted 900 DBT SQL scripts from Snowflake SQL to Databricks by optimizing queries using macros and UDFs, reducing query runtime by 50%.

Used DBT’s macros, Jinja, and tests for efficient data handling, quality, and dynamic SQL, implemented snapshots for history tracking and documentation for data lineage.

Implemented automated data quality checks in Databricks using Great Expectations and DBT tests, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and compliance before ingestion into analytical layers.



LAVSUN Technologies | Decemeber 2022 - March 2024 

Data Engineer

Responsibilities:

Improved storage efficiency with S3 partitioning, used Kafka for real-time ingestion, and optimized AWS Glue jobs to load data.

Implemented one-time migration of multi-state level data from Oracle DB to Snowflake using Python and Snow SQL.

Staged the API (in JSON file format) into Snowflake DB by FLATTENing it for different functional services.

Developed advanced SQL transformations in Snowflake, utilizing window functions, CTEs, and MERGE statements for incremental data.

Developed views and stored procedures in Snowflake to automate data loading and transformation processes.

Utilized Time Travel and Clone utilities in Snowflake for validating and fixing production issues efficiently.

Implemented data loading from internal and external stages into Snowflake using SNOWSQL andSnowpipes.

Designed and optimized data models in Power BI Desktop, using Power Query for data shaping,and writing advanced DAX expressions for calculated columns, measures, and KPI logic.



Infosys | December 2020 - July 2022  

Data Engineer

Responsibilities:

Migrated on-prem Hadoop workloads to Azure Synapse Analytics, orchestrating pipelines through ADF and Databricks for scalable, serverless ETL.

Designed and optimized Delta Lake architecture in ADLS Gen2, implementing data retention, lifecycle policies, and tiered storage management (Hot, Cool, Archive) to reduce costs by ~30%.

Developed PySpark and SQL transformations in Databricks using window functions, CTEs, and merge statements for incremental and historical (SCD Type 2) loads.

Implemented Z-Ordering, data skipping, and partition pruning to accelerate Synapse and Databricks analytical queries.

Implemented secure data access patterns by integrating Azure Active Directory (AAD) and Key Vault with Databricks and ADLS using service principals for fine-grained permissions.

Automated CI/CD for Databricks notebooks and Synapse SQL scripts with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, enabling versioned deployments and rollback support.

Established end-to-end monitoring with ADF activity logs, Synapse monitoring, and alerting pipelines for SLA compliance.

Managed team assignments, tracked testing progress, identified risks, and ensured timely delivery.

Worked closely with clients and stakeholders through regular status reporting and communication.

Supported UAT activities and ensured effective coordination between QA, business, and delivery teams.



Test Engineer | CVS Caremark – Genpact – India

Collaborated with development and business teams to troubleshoot defects, validate fixes, and maintain test documentation.

Abeedur Rahman Khan, PMPProject/Program Manager – IT Business Analyst || Telecommunication || Fiber Optic Network13432 Gardiner Ln, Milton, GA 30004 || khan_abeed@yahoo.com || +1 (470) 469 0482 || LinkedIn Profile



Executive Summary

PMP-certified Project Manager with over 18 years of global experience leading complex, compliance-driven technology initiatives across healthcare, telecom, and government sectors. Proven expertise in delivering security audit programs, cloud infrastructure transformations, and regulatory modernization projects aligned with NIST 800-53, HIPAA, and IRS Pub 1075 standards.

Adept at managing full project lifecycles—from initiation through execution and closure—ensuring scope, time, cost, and quality objectives are consistently met. Skilled in collaborating with diverse stakeholders including federal agencies, vendors, engineers, and legal teams to execute mission-critical programs with audit precision and operational excellence.

Track record includes leading enterprise-wide EHR modernization, regulatory compliance rollouts, and security control implementations for high-stakes environments. Strong command over PMO frameworks, risk management, and governance reporting, with executive-level communication skills and hands-on mastery of MS Project, SharePoint, Power BI, and O365.

Now seeking to bring my multidisciplinary project leadership to security-focused organizations where audit readiness, cross-agency collaboration, and regulatory alignment are mission-critical.

Core Competencies / Skills

Security Compliance & Audit Management

Project Lifecycle Management (SDLC/Agile)

MS Project, MS Visio, SharePoint 2013, MS O365

Scope, Time, Cost, and Quality Management

Vendor Coordination & Oversight

PMO Governance & Best Practices

Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

NIST 800-53, IRS Pub 1075 Standards

IT Risk & Vulnerability Management

PMO Achievements

Led the cloud-native migration of EHR systems with HIPAA and CMS interoperability compliance for a U.S. healthcare network, directly supporting ONC Health IT certification readiness—relevant for pharma-aligned clinical data governance.

Integrated GenAI-powered clinical documentation assistants to reduce physician note entry time by 30%, aligning with digitization efforts in clinical operations and trial workflows.

Applied NIST 800-53 controls to audit remediation projects for healthcare systems, aligning with GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements for secure data handling and system validation in regulated environments.

Supported enterprise risk mitigation and DevSecOps initiatives for systems handling protected health information (PHI), providing foundations for clinical trial data integrity and audit readiness.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams including data scientists, UX designers, and legal/compliance officers to implement AI/ML pipelines for lab data processing, ticket triage, and regulatory documentation.

Developed compliance dashboards and executive reports using Power BI to support pharmacovigilance monitoring and secure audit logs.

Familiar with pharma-adjacent systems and concepts including Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), electronic Trial Master File (eTMF), and Electronic Data Capture (EDC).

Participated in planning and governance of digital health programs that intersected with clinical research workflows, regulatory mandates, and FDA audit trails.

Led audit remediation projects aligned with NIST 800-53 controls for a state health department.

Directed cross-functional teams to implement corrective action plans post-security assessments.

Tracked milestones in MS Project and managed document repository on SharePoint 2013.

Conducted stakeholder briefings and project closeout reviews with executive sponsors.

Governance & Standardization: Ensured adherence to PMO governance frameworks, standardizing project management practices across multiple programs. Maintained compliance with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project methodologies.

Applied PMI-standard Project Lifecycle Framework (Initiation to Closure) across enterprise programs, ensuring structured project planning, governance alignment, and rigorous execution in compliance-driven environments

Project Tracking & Reporting: Developed and maintained dashboards to track KPIs, project progress, issue logs, and risk mitigation strategies. Generated executive reports to provide visibility into program health and budget utilization.

Proven Program Manager role with a strong track record of leading large-scale PLM-aligned initiatives across telecom, IT, and infrastructure domains—driving projects from concept through execution, including fiber rollouts, core network builds, and enterprise ERP transformations.

Financial & Resource Management: Assisted in project budgeting, financial forecasting, and resource allocation to optimize delivery efficiency. Monitored CAPEX/OPEX expenditures to ensure alignment with business goals and financial controls.

Stakeholder & Communication Management: Acted as a bridge between business stakeholders, IT teams, and vendors to align project execution with strategic goals. Facilitated executive-level communication through structured reporting and analysis.

Process Improvement & Compliance: Led process improvement initiatives to streamline project workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Ensured compliance with regulatory requirements, including risk assessments for IT and telecom projects.

Delivered executive-level presentations and reporting to C-suite stakeholders (CIO, CFO), and led steering committee sessions to drive alignment, risk resolution, and decision-making across cross-functional teams





Professional Experience

Project Manager | Maxiom Technology | Ashburn, VA | Jan 2025 – Present

 (IT Project Management | RPA Development | ERP Implementations | Digital Transformation)

1. NIST 800-53 Audit & Compliance Project

SITUATION: Maxiom was tasked with ensuring FCC and HIPAA compliance across multiple SaaS and cloud systems under a high-visibility government-facing portfolio.

TASK: As the Project Manager, I was responsible for planning and executing security audits aligned with NIST 800-53 and HIPAA, ensuring projects adhered to compliance timelines and policies.

ACTION: I developed an audit workstream using MS Project, defined scope and risk frameworks, tracked milestones in SharePoint, and collaborated with vendors and internal teams. I led the verification process post-execution and documented lessons learned.

RESULT: Successfully delivered 100% of audit projects within scope and schedule, improved risk mitigation tracking through Power BI dashboards, and achieved audit readiness with no major findings in the final review.

2. PMO Governance & AI-Driven Security Enhancements

SITUATION: There was a gap in project transparency and risk flagging for ongoing compliance programs overseen by regulatory agencies.

TASK: I needed to provide governance reporting to executive stakeholders while improving operational efficiency in regulatory workflows.

ACTION: I embedded OpenAI/GPT APIs for automated log and ticket summarization, integrated these insights into compliance dashboards, and aligned processes with PMO frameworks.

RESULT: Achieved a 35% reduction in compliance ticket turnaround time and delivered executive dashboards that enhanced visibility into risk areas across FCC-aligned portfolios.

3. Cloud-Native EHR Migration with HIPAA/CMS Compliance

SITUATION: A U.S.-based healthcare network struggled with outdated EHR systems, risking non-compliance with CMS interoperability rules and HIPAA mandates.

TASK: I was brought in to manage the enterprise-wide EHR migration to a secure, cloud-native platform and ensure regulatory compliance.

ACTION: I directed a cross-functional team, led agile ceremonies using JIRA, coordinated with Azure architects to enforce NIST 800-53 controls, and aligned with HIPAA/CMS requirements. I also introduced FHIR-based APIs for patient data access and enabled GenAI-based documentation tools.

RESULT: Delivered the program under budget ($7M) and ahead of schedule, passed audits with 100% compliance, reduced clinical documentation time by 30%, and positioned the client for ONC Health IT certification.

4. Regulatory Risk Mitigation & DevSecOps Implementation

SITUATION: The client faced upcoming ONC mandates and required a secure delivery pipeline for continuous compliance.

TASK: My objective was to implement DevSecOps pipelines that ensured audit readiness and alignment with evolving federal security policies.

ACTION: I established continuous delivery pipelines with built-in compliance gates, worked closely with QA and legal teams, and implemented performance metrics across the audit trail.

RESULT: Enabled automated audit tracking, improved release security by 40%, and empowered the organization with traceable compliance logs meeting ONC and IRS Pub 1075 requirements.

Professional Summary:

Experienced IT professional with over six years of expertise as a Manual and Automation Quality Assurance Analyst, specializing in the financial and banking sectors in testing and validating both web-based and client-server applications. 

Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), System Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and Defect Life Cycle. Proficient in Agile and Waterfall methodologies and experience with V-Model methodologies. 

Skilled in establishing Test Plans, Test Strategies, Test Scenarios, and Test Cases, by following Business Requirements and Software Requirement Specifications.

Experienced in preparing the Test plans, Scripts and Test cases by analyzing Business Requirements and various other ARTIFACTS with a strong ability at collaborating with Development team and Business Analysts to analyze the test scenarios.

Experienced in developing and implementing automated test scripts, while continuously analyzing and troubleshooting issues in close coordination with the development team.

Extensive experience in conducting a wide range of software testing activities, including Systems testing, Integration testing, Positive/Negative testing, Functionality testing and regression testing.

Well-versed in utilizing test management tool, JIRA to create tickets and track bugs. 

Hands-on experience working with automation testing tool Selenium WebDriver and TestNG.

Solid experience in the Capital Markets domain, with a strong understanding of financial instruments across both buy-side and sell-side operations. Well-versed in Equities (Common and Preferred Stocks), Fixed Income securities including U.S. Treasuries (Bonds, Notes, Bills, FRNs), and Derivative contracts such as Options, Futures, and Swaps.

Comprehensive understanding of Trading Platforms and testing them from the Business and as well as Technical Perspective.

Experienced working with Jenkins, GitHub and Maven for Continues Integration and Development.

Experienced in using Fix Protocol API for testing admin and application FIX messages like heartbeat, logon, logout, resend request, reject, sequence, pre-trade, trade and post-trade messages.

Skilled in utilizing the LINUX Terminal to extract and analyze FIX logs, with the capability to compare them against frontend and backend data inputs for effective troubleshooting. 

Extensive experience in developing SQL queries/scripts to validate the databases tables and reports data for backend database testing validation. 

Utilized VeriFix to simulate exchanges and run automated tests, including monitoring, verifying, and validating FIX messages to ensure the accuracy of data transmission and reception.

Motivated self-starter with a strong work ethic, dependability, and a passion for learning new skills.

Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team, with excellent communication and collaboration skills that enable effective coordination with colleagues and stakeholders.









Professional Experience:





Fidelity Investments                                                                                                       New York, NY                                                                                                          

Quality Assurance                                                                                                          October 2022-Current



Responsibilities:



Worked closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software products using Agile methodologies, actively participating in daily Scrum meetings to review milestones and track progress. 

Conducted in-depth analysis of business and specification requirement documents to ensure a comprehensive understanding of customer needs and project goals.

Tracked and documented defects using industry-standard tools such as JIRA and Bugzilla, ensuring all issues were accurately recorded, managed, and resolved. 

Performed system testing, documenting results or bug reports, test status reports, test results and summary reports. 

Collaborated with colleagues in the Quality Assurance and User Acceptance Testing teams to ensure comprehensive system testing. Developed a set of Test Scenarios tailored to the specific functionalities of each testing cycle.



Created SQL queries to extract and modify data from tables, compare them against GIU.

Good interpersonal skills, commitment, result oriented and working with quest and zeal to learn new technologies and systems.  







Murex                                                                                                                      New York, NY 

Quality Assurance                                                                                                   September 2020-October 2022



Responsibilities: 



Assisted in the creation of comprehensive test plans, crafted detailed test scripts, and diligently carried out test cases to verify the software's compliance with requirements, while also identifying and addressing any defects or issues.

Managed a detailed defect tracking system, systematically prioritizing and categorizing defects according to their severity and impact on the software.

Proactively identified and communicated potential risks to the Business Analyst and Project Manager, ensuring timely mitigation and avoidance of project delays.

Worked closely with the development team to facilitate timely corrections and collaborated with other testers and stakeholders in business meetings to evaluate progress and resolve issues.

Created test scenarios aligned with the system's functional specifications for each cycle, using a methodical approach to ensure comprehensive coverage and thorough testing of all critical use cases. 

Created and executed detailed test scripts and test cases to evaluate software functionality and identify defects, working closely with the development team to ensure prompt resolution of issues.

Conducted thorough re-testing to verify defect fixes and ensure that the software met all specified performance and reliability criteria.

Prepared and validated test data sets for data-driven and regression testing, collaborating closely with testers and stakeholders to ensure complete coverage of necessary data scenarios and that the test data accurately mirrored real-world usage patterns. 

Conducted multiple types of testing done on trading platform including but not limited to Functional, Regression, End-to-End, GUI, Smoke, Integration and Performance Testing.

Well-versed in trading and Settlement concepts, trade lifecycle and Straight Through Processing (STP), Order routing, FIX (Financial Information Exchange) protocol.

Constructed SQL queries to retrieve and analyze extensive datasets from multiple database tables, utilizing a range of SQL functions and syntax to ensure data accuracy and completeness. 

Heavily involved in production issues and taking full ownership in resolving them till closure.







HSBC Bank                                                                                                                  New York, NY 

Senior Quality Assurance Analyst                                                                               April 2019-September 2020



Responsibilities:



As a member of the Fixed Income team, actively involved in reviewing Business Requirements and Functional documents to develop comprehensive, effective test strategies, test plans, and test cases for projects following Agile/Scrum methodology. 

Collaborated extensively with the business team to analyze and fully comprehend their business requirements to deliver bug free and high-quality product.

Responsible for publishing daily reports to keep team members and management informed about the status of testing efforts, while highlighting any issues that may be causing delays in test script execution. 

Thoroughly documented all requirements, performed a comprehensive gap analysis to identify potential areas for improvement, and worked with SDLC team to implement necessary changes.

Maintained a streamlined defect life cycle management process using JIRA, including creating comprehensive defect reports, analyzing data to identify trends, and implementing process improvements as necessary.

Proficient in using Linux Terminal to access and analyze FIX logs, identify bug connectivity issues.

Extensively performing Backend testing by writing and executing SQL queries to retrieve, manipulate, and validate data from various databases.

Conducting GUI validations on menu bars, toolbars, textboxes, radio buttons, checkboxes, drop down lists, list boxes etc. using Selenium WebDriver. 

Extensive understanding of financial services and capital markets, covering various financial instruments such as equities, structured fixed income products, derivatives, and options. Proficient in Trade Life Cycle, Straight Through Processing (STP), order routing, and the FIX (Financial Information Exchange) protocol.

Test various stages of the Trade Life Cycle (TLC) Pre-Trade, Actual-Trade and Post-Trade to ensure that trades are successfully placed and executed without any issues. 

Following STP Straight Through Processing and testing the trade End-to-end workflow. 

Comprehensive in testing Trading applications for testing Derivatives (Future and Options), Fixed Income instruments in front and middle office through various OMS and EMS stages. 

Involvement in the Production Phase as well as responsibility for answering any potential questions asked past or during Production Phase.

My professional experience, dedication, and strong drive for success will contribute to organizational growth, enhance client satisfaction, and optimize financial performance.

Built an Eventing framework using Azure Event Grid, logic apps, Data Factory and SendGrid(email and SMS). This also includes Error handling framework.

Built various pipelines in ETL tools like ADF, Talend, AWS Glue.









Built dataflows in Mulesoft, performed mappings and transformations to extract data and write to Confluent Kafka topics.

Worked on Informatica (v9) to load the Clinical Trial Management System’s data into a warehouse.

Leveraged Cloud formation templates to automate instantiation of EC2 instances (redhat linux) and deploy the registry application (java, spring mvc, reactjs) backed by Oracle in RDS (multi zone for HA).

Configured error handling for workflows by sending an email automatically using the ‘Outbound Communication Manager’ to the admin whenever an exception happens in workflows. This process is generic to all Interfaces.

Installed the Siebel Charts Server and made the Siebel Charts functionality available for Protocols, Countries (Region), Contracts and Sites.





CRM Consultant

Blue Cross Blue Shield of North Carolina | Durham, NC



10/2008 – 04/2009

https://bluecrossnc.com Responsibilities:

Developed the Custom Business Component for Tracking experiences based on the Source table in Siebel and cloned the Product Line/Internal Product BCs for Programs and Solutions respectively.

Configured List/Form/Pick Applets, Views, Screens for displaying the Tracking Experiences, Programs and Solutions information under Large Group Opportunities (Account/Oppty).

Scripted the Custom Business Service to call a workflow which in turn creates the request property set, converts it to XML, then calls the proxy business service which in-turn triggers the webservice call via HTTP and gets back the response from OneView. All the documents like attachments and PPA documents generated from Siebel Proposal module are uploaded to FileNet using a Java based UI that’s exposed in Siebel using Symbolic URL. The documents are shared between Siebel and FileNet using a unique Id(Activity Id). The documents are displayed as links in a separate View, so user can view/download them from Siebel.

Developed an outbound webservice interfacing with EPLS(Excluded Parties List System) (https://www.epls.gov/ ) to run the Debarment for Partner Users(Contacts). In the process consumed the EPLS WSDL and created a workflow. Using the Integration Object imported through the WSDL I performed the UI Data mapping between the Siebel Integration Object and the external Integration Object. After which I call the webservice which posts the XML using HTTP Transport and gets back the response code and message which get updated at the Partner-Contact level.





















CRM Integration Consultant

Merck Pharmaceuticals | West Point, PA



08/2006 – 12/2007

https://merck.com Responsibilities:

Designed and Developed an Inbound interface with Customer Master (Siperian). This process Pub-Sub, where Customer Master publishes and Cornerstone (Siebel) subscribes for information.

This interface uses Tibco Siebel Adapter as the middleware, where Tibco plays a role in modifying and transporting the data in the form of XML. But no business rules are applied in Tibco. The logic is implemented in Siebel.

Designed and developed two interfaces with CIR (Customer Interaction Repository), one inbound and one outbound. The inbound interface is called 'CIR Get' and the outbound 'Cir Add/Update'.

Performed EIM jobs to import and cleanup data. Built the IFBs needed for the EIM jobs. Automated the EIM jobs making it easy for other developers to run it just on a mouse click. Informatica was used to load Siebel EIM tables with Customer Master data from flat files.





CRM Consultant

Janssen Pharmaceutical Companies of J&J | Titusville, NJ



07/2005 - 07/2006

https://janssen.com/us Responsibilities:

Involved in the Business requirements. Defined the source to target mappings and the business rules.

Developed the workflows and workflow policies required for Outbound Integration, which included build of workflow policy object, columns and programs.

Worked on the server-side tasks required for accepting the Incoming XMLs on to the WebServer from the Webmethods canonical like creating named subsystems and setting the business services to invoke the workflows.









Designed, documented and published Data Mappings based on the business requirements, required columns, User Keys and LOV values using Siebel Tools, EIM tables and Base Tables.

Loaded the data from VPIL tables to EIM Staging tables using customized tool through TOAD.





CRM Integration Consultant

One Call Care Medical | Parsipanny, NJ



04/2005 – 06/2005

https://onecallcm.com Responsibilities:

Extensively involved in Configuration of Accounts and Contacts Interface elements for the GUI.

Designed workflows in Siebel Tools (New in 7.7) and used vanilla Siebel adapters and custom business services.

Used the Siebel EAI Data Mapper to map Internal and External Integration Objects in Siebel Client.

Designed individual workflows for Contacts like patient, doctor, physician, agent, adjuster and Accounts like payer, employer, and company.

Also created major workflows based on the base tables, which call the above workflows as sub processes.



Web Developer

Sify India Pvt. Limited | Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India



11/2002 - 11/2004

https://sifytechnologies.com Responsibilities:

Designing and Development of UIs for Sify Channels and for various products offered by the company.

Involved in creating web advertisements like animated banners, text banners, popup advertisements, shoshkeles, insliders and interstitials to increase the Ad revenue by getting more click thrus on the 67 Sify Channels.

Specialized in designing Microsites for clients like Standard Chartered, HDFC, ICICI, Citibank and various other organizations and their products.

Designing the showcasing images and icons on Sify webpages which will lead to other channels.

737-757-6305 | sangeethakanamarlapudi@gmail.com 
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/sangeetha-kanamarlapudi
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Senior Network & Data Platform Program Manager with 18+ years of experience leading large-scale network 
observability, telemetry analytics, and AI-driven operational intelligence programs across enterprise environments. 
Proven expertise delivering real-time monitoring platforms, streaming data ecosystems, and production-grade 
alerting frameworks for wired and wireless infrastructures. 
Strong background in network instrumentation, event-driven architectures, incident response leadership, and 
reliability engineering. Experienced in translating telemetry data into actionable dashboards, intelligent alerting 
strategies, and measurable improvements in uptime, MTTR, and operational efficiency. 
 
CORE TECHNICAL EXPERTISE 
Network & Telemetry Systems 
● Network telemetry architecture and instrumentation 
● SNMP-based monitoring and device event collection 
● Network/Element Management system integrations 
● Layer 2 / Layer 3 switching, routing, VLANs, RF optimization 
● Infrastructure health metrics and operational analytics 
Streaming & Data Platforms 
● Real-time streaming ingestion (Apache Kafka ecosystem) 
● Event-driven data pipelines 
● Time-series data platforms and performance metrics 
● SQL-based analytics and data validation 
● Snowflake, DB2 modernization programs 
Observability & Monitoring 
● Splunk and ELK-based log analytics and search optimization 
● Dashboard development and executive reporting 
● Alert correlation logic and noise reduction 
● Incident triage and production troubleshooting 
● Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and runbook improvements 
AI / Automation 
● Anomaly detection models for infrastructure monitoring 
● Predictive diagnostics and performance baselining 
● ML lifecycle governance and KPI tracking 
● Python-based automation and scripting 
● Auto-remediation workflows 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
VENTURA FOODS | Irvine, CA | Senior Program Manager – Data, Network & AI Platforms August 2024 – Present 

● Led $3.5M enterprise modernization initiative migrating legacy DB2 systems to Snowflake while enabling 
real-time operational analytics. 
● Established telemetry-driven monitoring framework connecting infrastructure data, business metrics, and 
executive dashboards. 
● Designed data validation and quality controls for high-volume streaming ingestion pipelines. 
● Built executive observability dashboards integrating performance KPIs, infrastructure metrics, and risk 
indicators. 
● Partnered with operations teams to streamline production troubleshooting workflows, improving incident 
response coordination. 
● Delivered 25% improvement in data accuracy and reduced duplicate system overhead. 
● Led enterprise wired and wireless network modernization initiatives including switching upgrades, AP 
deployments, and infrastructure optimization. 
● Facilitated outage triage coordination during network disruptions, driving faster resolution and structured 
post-incident analysis. 
 
INTEL CORPORATION | Engineering Program Manager – Predictive Telemetry & AI Analytics   Oct 2021 – July 2024 
● Directed large-scale device health telemetry platform supporting real-time ingestion and analytics across 
distributed ChromeOS devices. 
● Partnered with engineering to implement streaming pipelines and operational dashboards enabling 
proactive failure detection. 
● Reduced manual device triage time by 30% through predictive diagnostics and anomaly detection models. 
● Improved device reliability metrics by 15% through telemetry-based monitoring strategies. 
● Led cross-functional coordination between engineering, SRE, and operations during production incident 
resolution. 
● Established model governance including drift monitoring, validation reviews, and measurable reliability 
KPIs. 
● Connected telemetry outputs to executive-level reporting to quantify operational savings ($800K 
annually). 
 
CISCO SYSTEMS | Technical Program Manager – Self-Optimizing Network (SON) Platform     May 2019 – Sept 2021 
Led development of a Self-Optimizing Network (SON) web application focused on RF performance optimization, 
automated configuration tuning, and enterprise network health monitoring. 
● Directed end-to-end delivery of RF optimization software improving signal quality, coverage efficiency, and 
throughput performance across enterprise deployments. 
● Led architectural transformation of legacy monolithic application into a scalable microservices-based 
platform, improving deployment agility and service resilience. 
● Coordinated backend service decomposition, API gateway implementation, containerization strategy, and 
CI/CD enablement. 
● Enabled real-time telemetry ingestion from network devices to support performance baselining and 
automated optimization logic. 
● Partnered with engineering teams to implement event-driven communication between services for 
scalable alert processing. 
 

● Established observability standards including centralized logging, health checks, service monitoring, and 
performance dashboards. 
● Collaborated with operations teams to improve incident diagnostics through improved service visibility 
and telemetry instrumentation. 
● Improved system scalability and reduced production defects through modular service isolation and 
automated regression validation. 
● Supported RF planning, VLAN segmentation, and wireless performance optimization across enterprise 
customers. 
 
POLYCOM (HP) |  Technical Program Manager –VoIP & Embedded Communication Systems Nov 2016 – April 2019 
Led development and integration of VoIP software platforms for enterprise IP phones and conferencing devices, 
supporting real-time voice communication and unified collaboration systems. 
● Managed end-to-end delivery of VoIP software stack integration including SIP signaling, RTP media 
handling, codec management, and call control workflows. 
● Coordinated firmware, hardware, and software teams to enable seamless integration across IP desk 
phones and conferencing endpoints. 
● Directed cross-functional integration of Polycom VoxBox voice collaboration platform, ensuring 
interoperability with enterprise VoIP infrastructure. 
● Led system-level validation of call setup, session management, and voice quality metrics (latency, jitter, 
packet loss). 
● Partnered with QA and network engineering teams to troubleshoot production VoIP issues impacting call 
stability and device registration. 
● Oversaw REST/SOAP API integrations enabling device provisioning, remote configuration, and monitoring. 
● Improved validation efficiency by 25% through automation frameworks for regression testing of VoIP call 
flows and firmware releases. 
● Ensured interoperability with enterprise call managers and unified communications platforms. 
● Facilitated root cause analysis of signaling failures, codec mismatches, and network performance-related 
call drops. 
● Drove release governance for VoIP firmware updates, ensuring high availability and minimal production 
disruption. 
 
CISCO SYSTEMS | Project Lead –  RMS Web Application (4G/5G Call Processing) Aug 2013 – Nov 2016 
Managed development of RMS (Resource Management System) web application supporting 4G and 5G mobile 
device call processing workflows and telecom infrastructure operations. 
● Led cross-functional teams delivering web-based system handling high-volume mobile call session 
processing and device state management. 
● Coordinated integration with telecom network components supporting LTE and early 5G infrastructure 
environments. 
● Supported real-time event handling and session lifecycle management across distributed services. 
● Partnered with engineering teams to ensure performance optimization for high-throughput mobile traffic 
scenarios. 
 
● Facilitated production issue triage impacting mobile device call handling and service reliability. 

● Drove improvements in system performance, reducing latency in call state transitions and resource 
allocation. 
● Oversaw API integrations and backend services enabling device monitoring and configuration 
management. 
● Supported root cause analysis of network performance and signaling issues across telecom environments. 
● Ensured reliability of critical telecom workflows through structured testing, release governance, and 
operational readiness reviews. 
 
TE CONNECTIVITY (Tyco Electronics) | Software Engineer – EMS/NMS Web Applications & Network Device 
Management                                                                                                                                                                2007 – 2013 
Led development of Element Management Systems (EMS) and Network Management Systems (NMS) for managing 
SNMP-enabled telecom and broadband devices including WiMAX, DSL, and SONET infrastructure components. 
● Designed and developed web-based EMS/NMS applications supporting remote monitoring, configuration, 
and fault management of network devices. 
● Implemented SNMP-based device communication (traps, polling, MIB management) for real-time device 
telemetry and event handling. 
● Built performance and fault management modules tracking alarms, threshold breaches, and device health 
indicators. 
● Supported management of WiMAX base stations, DSL aggregation devices, and SONET transport systems. 
● Developed backend services for device discovery, topology mapping, and network inventory management. 
● Enabled trap processing and alarm correlation workflows to reduce duplicate alerts and improve 
operational visibility. 
● Partnered with field engineering teams to troubleshoot connectivity, provisioning, and protocol-level 
issues. 
● Supported configuration management workflows for firmware upgrades, remote provisioning, and device 
parameter updates. 
● Led root cause analysis for performance degradation across broadband and transport network layers. 
● Contributed to protocol-level validation across Layer 2/Layer 3 networking and SONET transport 
architecture. 
 
EDUCATION 
MS in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning – Liverpool John Moores University 
Post Graduate Diploma in Data Science – IIIT Bangalore 
B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics Engineering 
 
CERTIFICATIONS 
PMP – Project Management Institute 
Generative AI – Microsoft Azure OpenAI
